title: search of biomarker for prognosis of acute dissection type B wth biologic and radiologic marker
summary: Analysis of blood components and examination of imaging collected for your treatment with a search for a biomarker to clarify possible complications of acute and chronic course of aortic dissection

interventions.name:
pt. with aortic dissection
Blood test every 6 months - 5 years (exception: patients with aortic aneurysm for a maximum of 1 year)
Routine magnetic resonance therapy

pt. without aortic disease
blood text once

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-pt with aortic dissection type A
-pt with aortic dissection type B
-pt with aortic dissection typy NonA-NonB
or
-pt with non aortic disease
Exclusion criteria:
-without informed consent
- < 18 age
